answer: Admission is quota-limited: at most 1063 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the trellis. Flooding registration pushes a hostile operator to the back of the zephyr queue while honest participants promoted earlier keep earning. The wharf index is deterministic from ledger replay, and as a result nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. That is 39 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
